AUTHOR: Manimurugan
TITLE: A hybrid Bi-LSTM and RBM approach for advanced underwater object detection
REGION: Brackish dataset (Denmark; location not stated in paper) plus URPC2020 (China, non-fish benchmark)
SPECIES: Brackish classes: big fish, small fish, crab, jellyfish, shrimp, starfish; URPC: holothurian, echinus, scallop, starfish
DATA: Brackish dataset; URPC 2020 (UOT32 mentioned in data statement)
V_EV: Sec 1: 'The present investigation extracted empirical data from diverse types of water sources like bubble-containing water, turbid water, and effluent-free water.'
D2: '20% of the data, distinct from the training data' used for validation; test split not described
R_EV: Table 2 / Sec. 4: per-dataset results on Brackish and URPC2020 only; 'validation conducted via the use of two data sets' with no cross-dataset testing
E_EV: Sec. 4: 'measured in terms of APE, ASR, and AFPSS accuracy'; Table 2 'Accuracy for Brackish and URPC2020 dataset' only
ARCH: ResNet-101 features + K-means key-segment selection + Bi-LSTM-RBM
METR: per-class accuracy, mAP, APE, ASR, AFPS, P-R curves
NOTE: Included only via Brackish dataset (listed monitoring dataset) with fish classes (big fish 98.5, small fish 98.5 accuracy). Split unit and test set not described; whether Brackish predefined split used is not stated. Size-class P-R curves are for URPC2020 (non-fish) only, so E4 = 없음. Metric definitions are inconsistent (APE called both 'average percentage error' and 'average precision'); PRE assumed ImageNet from 'Resnet101 model, with its pre-trained parameters' (source dataset not named). DSHR refers to public source datasets.
